thread:
megan: Quick experiment idea for PLG funnel: micro-credit drip + 3 starter prompt templates behind a tiny webinar. Aim: move registrant->first-api-call by +15% in 7 days.

sam: sounds good. what's the ask from growth?

megan: run a small paid slice (2k budget) + organic posts. offer 600 tokens at signup, 400 on attendance. short demo, then 2 follow-up micro-posts linking to prompt templates.

leo: landing needs clear CTA + claim flow. recommend auto-apply 600 on signup, but require a one-click claim for the 400 to avoid fraud.

anya: email subject test: "Get tokens to build with Redwood Inference" vs "Free tokens + runnable prompts". also test hero: code-first vs outcomes-first.

growth-bot: recommended channels: Twitter devs, Hacker News pin, targeted GitHub placements. suggested budget split: 60% paid, 40% organic.

analytics-bot: Adding events: `microcredit_signup`, `microcredit_attend`, `microcredit_claim`, `first_api_call`. include utm props.

megan: UX note: claim modal should include a small runnable prompt and a "Run now with credits" button. reduces drop-off.

leo: dev note: landing query string: `?utm_source={{source}}&utm_campaign=microcredit_0501&cohort={{variant}}`. will instrument cohort param.

anya: creative: 1 banner, 3 social microcopy variants, 2 email templates, 1 tiny prompt pack (3 prompts). Tone: pragmatic + low friction.

megan: timeline: draft copy Mon, landing ready Wed, webinar Thu. growth to seed ads Tue. analytics dashboard tile for cohort comparison pls.

sam: noted. I'll own paid buys and reporting. will share audience segments by EOD.

megan: small legal/privacy note: credits only for hosted API; add a line on the claim page.

leo: will add. PR link when ready.

megan: action items recap: megan=experiment owner, anya=copy + A/B, leo=landing + instrument, sam=growth buys, analytics-bot=dashboard. check-in Wed. :rocket:
